text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has won this race with<n>ease! She truly
stands apart from the<n>rest! We've witnessed
something<n>incredible today, folks!
Blip.

I've watched Narita Brian's<n>Japanese Derby race
countless times<n>already.

Once the autumn Tenno Sho is over,<n>we'll be up
against her at the Arima<n>Kinen.

And I have a feeling she'll be even<n>better than she
was at the Derby...

It's the final day to make<n>adjustments for the
autumn Tenno<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That time's not too bad. All right!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to go over these results in our<n>meeting. And
just to be sure, let's<n>take a look at the dirt track
data from<n>the other day, so—
choice_data_list: It's a good thing I have it ready, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you. You've really been<n>on top of your
game recently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I daresay you might even be a little<n>too on top of
your game.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think we've gone over everything<n>we can for
today. Now we just have<n>to wait for the autumn
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to bed early tonight. I'd<n>hate to oversleep
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Try not to read too much into it.<n>I'm just
saying we should both be<n>careful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: All right, then. See you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

After Biwa Hayahide leaves my<n>office, I decide to
tie up some loose<n>ends before resting up for
tomorrow.

I still need to organize our meeting<n>minutes... I
already checked current<n>Tokyo Racecourse
conditions...

And I've replied to that reporter's<n>email... What
else do I need to do? I<n>hope I'm not forgetting
anything.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

Biwa Hayahide has been pretty<n>fatigued recently. I
need to order<n>some of those new icing products to
help with that...
Click.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What? Did you think I hadn't noticed<n>anything off
about you lately?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Geez...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has taken the lead! Her<n>opponents may
be the finest racers<n>out there, but she's not giving
up her<n>spot, folks!
Blip.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Look at you—sitting here at your<n>computer in the
dark and leaving the<n>TV on despite not watching it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What's worse is that you're playing<n>nothing but
footage from Brian's<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why are you taking all of this on by<n>yourself?
Shouldn't we be working<n>on it together?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you overwork yourself and<n>collapse, I'll have to
face the race all<n>by myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How can I do that after we've been<n>working so
long on the winning<n>equation together?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry isn't going to cut it. I'm<n>mad.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You don't understand how important<n>you are to me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for you, I probably never<n>would have
made my debut.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And during the Classics, I probably<n>would have
been paralyzed with<n>anxiety because of how much
better<n>Ticket and Taishin were than me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You made me who I am today. You're<n>the reason
I've been able to pursue<n>my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day we decided to<n>rebuild my
winning equation from<n>scratch... No, since even
before that! If<n>not for you, I—

Her shoulders are shaking, her eyes<n>are rimmed
with red... And it's dark.

My computer screen must've<n>switched off at some
point.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The second you get home, rest.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: One last thing...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We're a team. One of us doing this<n>without the
other would be like trying<n>to win a race with one leg.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And we're in this to win, right?

I move my bedtime up a little earlier<n>from this day
forward.

I need to be in top condition so we<n>can solve her
winning equation.<n>Together.
